401(k) contribution

Verified against the calculator

Your employer matches what you put into your 401(k), up to a limit.

Contributing 4% earns the full employer match of $2,600.00 a year, so no match is left on the table.

  • Matching contributions help you save more for retirement (IRS, Retirement Plans): https://www.irs.gov/retirement-plans/matching-contributions-help-you-save-more-for-retirement
  • 2026 limit on 401(k) elective deferrals (IRS Notice 2025-67): https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/n-25-67.pdf
